Installing Developer Tools

The plugin must be used with the vscode. Download the vscode 1.70.0 or later from the official website.

1.Heading for plugin download page, download and install the plugin package Macle_xx.x.x_DevSuite_IDE.zip. Currently, Windows and Mac OS are supported.

2.Installing the Plugin

F&Qs

What do I do if the error message "Failed to activate the extension 'MacleTeam.macle-miniprogram-tools': Unexpected token {" is displayed during plugin installation?

A: This error occurs because the VS Code of an earlier version has been installed. You can update the VS Code. For details about the installation process, see Developer Tool Installation.
